facts.fact: The essay's Somalia police row states that rural police stations predominantly keep paper occurrence books or station diaries, crime registers and lost-property, lock-up and prisoners' property registers, citing the Somali Police Basic Recruit Curriculum, which trains on police books and forms and mentions no digital tool, and scores the row 1; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.
facts.system: occurrence books (OB)/station diaries and crime registers
